about: Cameras tethering was tried with, and how well it works. Shown in the tether panel for the connected camera and listed in docs/TETHER_CAMERAS.md (keep both in step; a test checks it). Levels: tested (measured by the Rawtonic project on a body), reported (a user's camera test report says it works), notSupported (Rawtonic refuses to connect it). 'match' holds the camera library's model names, 'matchPrefix' a start of them. Timings are medians / 95th percentiles in milliseconds; 'photoOnScreen' was measured by screen recording, shutter request to the new photo shown in Develop.

cameras.name: Sony α7 III
cameras.notes: In AF-S a shot that finds no focus is not exposed; the camera reports nothing for it.

cameras.name: Sony α7 IV
cameras.notes: The ISO list shows the extended values as "Multi Frame Noise Reduction"; choosing one changes nothing.

cameras.name: Fujifilm X-H2S
cameras.notes: Live view shows about 3 frames a second and stops after a shot. With image review set to Continuous the camera refuses the next remote shot until the review is dismissed. Keeps its card copy of each photo.

cameras.name: Fujifilm GFX 50R
cameras.notes: No live view. Refuses shots as busy for about 3 seconds after connecting. Writes no card copy in USB tether mode: the library copy is the only one.

cameras.name: Canon EOS cameras
cameras.notes: Not offered yet: no Canon body has been tested, and the camera library can lose the report of a photo on these bodies.
